[[File:Dream icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Dream''' is a [[Lunar spell]] that causes the caster to fall asleep, during which time [[hitpoints]] will regenerate three times faster than normal, healing 1 hitpoint every 20 seconds, or 3 hitpoints per minute. Players must complete [[Dream Mentor]] to cast it.

The dream effect will remain indefinitely, ending only once the caster reaches full health, at which point it can't be re-cast until losing health. However, the dream will be interrupted if the caster does anything except chat or change [[armour]]. Poison damage '''will''' interrupt the dream.

Dream's healing effect will add to other regenerative effects, with both effects going off the base healing rate of 1 hitpoint per minute. As Dream runs on a separate timer from the player's main hitpoints regeneration,{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1044158332502716416|date=24 September 2018|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/109723|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=It sort of uses its own timer, separate from the main one.}} the two regeneration timers may not restore hitpoints at exactly the same time. ==Trivia==
*Trying to cast Dream within the [[Nightmare Zone]] yields the message "''You cannot perform Inception here. Dreaming within this dream will inevitably activate your Kick (i.e. Waking up from the dream).''" This is a reference to the 2010 film ''{{wp|Inception}}''.
*When players have the [[jar of dreams]] in their inventory while casting the spell, the screen will slowly turn black, and [[The Nightmare]]'s face will show up, together with the sound of the [[Armadyl crossbow]]'s special attack.
